svg.aria-label: Why ferrule wins: a for-loop around an API call versus the ferrule harness — per-model harness profiles, structured compaction, verify_command as judge, never-stuck recovery and a per-call ledger; OpenAI measured the same model at 13.3% versus 38.3% on ARC-AGI-3 depending on the harness
svg.text: Why ferrule wins
Same model, same prompt. The harness around the call is the difference.
A for-loop around an API call
the do-it-yourself agent loop
one prompt shape for every model
reasoning thrown away after each turn
history truncated at ~95% of the window
finished when the model says it's finished
a repeated tool loop ends in an error
fine for a demo — then the model outgrows it
vs
The ferrule harness
ships today, wraps every provider
harness profile per model
context window · compaction point · reasoning retention · dialect
structured compaction at ~70–75%
tool results deduplicated for free, then a checklist summary
verify_command — the build is the judge
the run can't finish until cargo test (or yours) passes
never stuck
jittered retries · loop detector · a truthful status at every stop
per-call ledger
tokens · cache hits · latency · cost — ferrule ledger --since 7d
default harness
engineered harness
Same model (GPT-5.6 Sol) on ARC-AGI-3 — and ~6× fewer output tokens.
